wan.title: Internet interface
wan.description: The network interface (as named in the network settings) through which traffic goes out to the internet directly.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Off - when ReCheck is overloaded, packets pass on without processing. On - such packets are dropped, so nothing slips past the bypass.

persist.title: Keep what was learned on flash
persist.description: Off - what ReCheck has learned is kept in memory and lost on reboot. On - it is written to flash, so after a reboot the working bypass methods are already known.

watch_active.title: Check downloads
watch_active.description: ReCheck also notices when a download from a watched site stalls. It needs at least one check address.

probe_resources.title: Check addresses
probe_resources.description: Up to four addresses of files on the sites to watch, https://site/path, separated by spaces. ReCheck uses them to see that downloads from these sites keep going.

cache_limit.title: Site limit
cache_limit.description: How many sites ReCheck remembers. 0 - no limit; otherwise at least 16, the least recently used are forgotten first.

family_limit.title: Site family limit
family_limit.description: How many groups of related sites ReCheck remembers. 0 - no limit; otherwise at least 16.

predict_limit.title: Prediction limit
predict_limit.description: How many predictions about new sites ReCheck remembers. 0 - no limit; otherwise at least 16.
